debugData.name: Alpine ice cracks
debugData.description: 2 decals on the terrain block showcaseAlpine, exported by the Ækasha terrain add-on in the block's space. The default mesh encode (meshopt, quantized) keeps them within about 2 mm of the export, well inside the 1.5 cm they lie over the block, and their UVs within a quarter texel of a 2K atlas.
